name: Get the Goblins Drunk

meta.previous: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
prev_q: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout

summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard asks you to test Fool's Stout on a pit crew. Choose the goblins and carry the stout to the nearby Goblin Pit Boss before it goes bad.

sections.title: A Test on the Pit Crews
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard gives you Fool's Stout to test on one of the pit crews. If you choose the goblins, take it to the nearby Goblin Pit Boss at the Mirage Raceway. That choice tips the races toward the gnomes. The stout will go bad eventually, so Kravel warns you not to dawdle.

sections.title: A Little Won't Hurt
sections.body: The Goblin Pit Boss sees the booze you offer and agrees to have a little.

aliases: who gives get the goblins drunk
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, a dwarf at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles, offers you the stout.

faq.q: Where must the stout be taken?
faq.answer: Take the stout to the Goblin Pit Boss, who is nearby at the Mirage Raceway.

faq.q: What happens if you wait too long?
faq.answer: The stout will go bad eventually, so Kravel warns you not to wait too long.

faq.q: What is the alternative to this?
faq.answer: Kravel lets you choose which pit crew to test the stout on. The alternative is Get the Gnomes Drunk, with the gnome crew.

aliases: prereq for get the goblins drunk
faq.answer: It follows Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout.

faq.q: What comes after the stout is delivered?
aliases: what comes after get the goblins drunk
faq.answer: The chain continues with Report Back to Fizzlebub.
